div.div:
Notation
box with component icon = «component»; nested = runs inside it
dashed box = «external» system
thick line = connector, label = protocol; open arrow = one-way connector
dashed frame opt [ ] = optional part
Component responsibilities and connector protocols: see README element catalog.
